{{Infobox/Weapon |rarity = Epic |slayer_level_requirement = Enderman Slayer 5 |dungeon_level_requirement = {{Skl|catacombs|15}} (when dungeonized) |damage = +310 |strength = +40 |crit_chance = +10% |crit_damage = +110% |shot_cooldown = 0.5s |enchantable = y |reforgeable = y |auctionable = y |museum = y |museum_xp = 7 |museum_category = combat |type = [[Bow]] |id = JUJU_SHORTBOW |raw_materials=*819200 Nether Quartz *4096 Null Sphere *163840 Obsidian *10240 Ender Pearl *1024 Blaze Rod *30720 String |mat_cost_bazaar=*32 Enchanted Quartz Block *32 Null Ovoid *32 Enchanted Eye of Ender *192 Enchanted String }} The '''Juju Shortbow''' is an {{Epic}} [[Bow]] unlocked at {{CollectionLink|Enderman Slayer LVL 5}}. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Enderman Slayer V}} |B1 = Enchanted Eye of Ender, 32 |C1 = Enchanted String, 64 |A2 = Null Ovoid, 32 |C2 = Enchanted String, 64 |B3 = Enchanted Quartz Block, 32 |C3 = Enchanted String, 64 |Output = Juju Shortbow }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Bow |name = Juju Shortbow |rarity = e |damage = 310 |crit_damage = 110 |crit_chance = 10 |strength = 40 |special_effect = Hits {{Red|3}} mobs on impact.
Can damage endermen. }} The '''Juju Shortbow''', upon impact, creates a {{Green|3}}-block radius that damages up to {{Green|3}} mobs, with each mob taking the full initial damage. The '''Juju Shortbow''' can damage {{MobSprite|Enderman;Endermen}}. == Essence Crafting == This weapon can be upgraded with Dragon Essence. Once converted, it requires {{Skl|catacombs|15}} to use. {{Essence Crafting |30 |60 |120 |200 |300 |convert = 150 |essence = Dragon |type = weapon }} == Fire rate == When left-clicking, the fire rate starts at 2.22 shots per second (9 ticks per shot) with 0 {{Stat|bas}} and increases to 5 shots per second (4 ticks per shot) with 100 {{Stat|bas}}.https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ATm1kO86bM0emKsuC7nAwazXDxNbEnkASSWSMjfIZc8/edit?usp=sharing The increase in fire rate with {{Stat|bas}} is incremental, not continuous. The maximum possible fire rate that can be achieved by optimal left-clicking depending on the player's {{Stat|bas}}: {| class="wikitable" ! rowspan="2" |Shot Cooldown ! colspan="2" |{{Stat|bas}} ! rowspan="2" |Shots per second |- !Lowest !Highest |- !0.45s(9 ticks) |< -8 |11 |2.22 |- !0.35s(7 ticks) |12 |40 |2.86 |- !0.25s(5 ticks) |41 |66 |4.00 |- !0.20s(4 ticks) |67 |100 |5.00 |} == Trivia == * It is one of 5 bows which can damage Endermen, the others being the {{LI|Explosive Bow}}, {{LI|Spider Queen's Stinger}}, {{LI|Terminator}}, and {{LI|Bonemerang}}. *If Arrows are in the Inventory when right-clicking, the bow drawback animation will play, causing the player to slow down, and arrows are not fired at the normal rate. Left-clicking still works as intended. *Before the Trading Update, you could use this weapon inside dungeons without having Enderman Slayer 3 if you had the Catacombs requirement to use it. However, this glitch was patched. *The lore implies that the AOE ability deals damage on the spot of impact. However, it used to take effect around the player instead of the mob the arrows hit. This is a patched bug. *When left-clicking on a mob with the Juju Shortbow in melee range, arrows will not be fired. Right-clicking will fire arrows as intended. *This, along with the Terminator, were the first shortbows. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/Sep 2|link=none|Now displays shot cooldown in lore.}} {{History|2026/Jun 24|[[File:Juju Shortbow (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Juju Shortbow''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} {{History|2026/Sep 30|Fixed {{Enchant|Piercing}} enchantment not working on {{item|Juju Shortbow}}s.}} |beta= {{History|2021/May 27|link=none|Preview of Juju Shortbow in a forum post.https://hypixel.net/threads/upcoming-nerfs-to-strength-stat-aiming-enchant.4265947/}} {{History|2021/May 31|[[File:Juju Shortbow (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Juju Shortbow'''.}} {{History|2021/Aug 17|link=none|Fixed being able to bypass the Slayer level requirement when the item is dungeonized and used within Dungeons.}} {{History|2022/June 22|Fixed '''Juju Shortbow''' hitting 3 mobs on impact sometimes not working.}} {{History|2022/Sep 28|Raised [[Enderman Slayer]] requirement from 3 to 5.}} {{History|0.26|[[File:Juju Shortbow (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Juju Shortbow''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Bows}} {{Nav/Slayer/Enderman}} [[Category:Shortbows]]
